'''''Prasium''''', common name '''white hedge-nettle,'''<ref>[http://www.flowersinisrael.com/Prasiummajus_page.htm Israel Wildflowers]</ref><ref>[http://maltawildplants.com/LABT/Prasium_majus.php Wild Plants of Malta & Gozo]</ref> is a genus of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Lamiaceae]], first described in 1982. It contains only one known species, '''''Prasium majus''''', first described for modern science in 1753. It is native to [[Madeira]], the [[Canary Islands]], and the [[Mediterranean]] region of [[Europe]], [[North Africa]], and the [[Middle East]], as far east as [[Turkey]], [[Cyprus]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prasium majus L. - Encyclopedia of Life |url=https://eol.org/pages/2917683 |access-date=2022-12-26 |website=eol.org}}</ref> and Israel.<ref name=c>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=164640 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Castroviejo, S. & al. (eds.) (2010). Flora Iberica 12: 1-650. Real Jardín Botánico, CSIC, Madrid.</ref><ref>Bergmeier, E., Blockeel, T., Böhling, N., Fournaraki, C., Gotsiou, P., Jahn, R., Lansdown, R. & Turland, N. (2011). An inventory of the vascular plants and bryophytes of Gavdopoula island (S Aegean, Greece) and its phytogeographical significance. Willdenowia 41: 179-190.</ref><ref>Dobignard, A. & Chatelain, C. (2012). Index synonymique de la flore d'Afrique du nord 4: 1-431. Éditions des conservatoire et jardin botaniques, Genève.</ref><ref>[https://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=prasium+majus Altervista Flora Italiana, The siciliano,  Prasium majus L. ] includes photos plus European distribution map</ref>
